Umhlaba wawungenasimo futhi ungenalutho. Ubumnyama babumboze amanzi ajulile, futhi uMoya kaNkulunkulu wawunyakaza phezu kwamanzi.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona ukukhanya." Kwase kuba khona ukukhanya.
UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi ukukhanya kuhle. Wehlukanisa ukukhanya nobumnyama.
UNkulunkulu wabiza ukukhanya ngokuthi "imini", nobumnyama wabubiza ngokuthi "ubusuku". Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lokuqala.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona isikhala esibanzi phakathi kwamanzi, sehlukanise amanzi abe yizingxenye ezimbili."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wenza isikhala esibanzi. Wehlukanisa amanzi angaphansi kwaso namanzi angaphezu kwaso. Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabiza isikhala esibanzi ngokuthi "isibhakabhaka". Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesibili.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Amanzi angaphansi kwesibhakabhaka mawabuthane endaweni eyodwa, ukuze kubonakale umhlabathi owomile." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabiza umhlabathi owomile ngokuthi "izwe", namanzi ayebuthene wawabiza ngokuthi "izilwandle". UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Izwe malimilise izitshalo: izitshalo eziluhlaza ezenza imbewu, nemithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo." Kwaba njengoba esho.
Izwe lamilisa izitshalo ezenza imbewu, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso, nemithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu ngaphakathi, ngamunye ngohlobo lwawo. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesithathu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Makube khona izinto ezikhanyayo esibhakabhakeni zehlukanise imini nobusuku. Mazibe yizimpawu eziphawula izinkathi zonyaka, izinsuku neminyaka.
Mazikhanye esibhakabhakeni zinike umhlaba ukukhanya." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wenza izinto ezimbili ezinkulu ezikhanyayo: esikhulu ukuba sibuse imini, nesincane ukuba sibuse ubusuku. Wenza nezinkanyezi.
UNkulunkulu wazibeka esibhakabhakeni ukuze zinike umhlaba ukukhanya,
zibuse imini nobusuku, futhi zehlukanise ukukhanya nobumnyama. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesine.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Amanzi magcwale izidalwa eziphilayo, nezinyoni mazindize phezu komhlaba esibhakabhakeni esivulekile."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wadala izilwane ezinkulu zasolwandle nazo zonke izinhlobo zezinto eziphilayo ezinyakazayo emanzini. Wadala nazo zonke izinhlobo zezinyoni. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wazibusisa wathi: "Zalanini nande. Gcwalisani amanzi ezilwandle, nezinyoni mazande emhlabeni."
Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesihlanu.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Izwe malikhiphe izidalwa eziphilayo, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso: imfuyo, izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi, nezilwane zasendle." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wenza izilwane zasendle, imfuyo nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi, ngasinye ngohlobo lwaso. UNkulunkulu wabona ukuthi kuhle.
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Masenze abantu ngomfanekiso wethu, bafane nathi. Mababuse izinhlanzi zasolwandle, izinyoni zezulu, imfuyo, umhlaba wonke, nazo zonke izilwanyana ezincane ezihamba phansi."
Ngakho uNkulunkulu wadala abantu ngomfanekiso wakhe. Wabadala ngomfanekiso kaNkulunkulu. Wabadala owesilisa nowesifazane.

UNkulunkulu wababusisa wathi kubo: "Zalanini nande. Gcwalisani umhlaba, niwunakekele futhi niwuphathe. Busani izinhlanzi zasolwandle, izinyoni zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa eziphilayo ezinyakazayo emhlabeni."
UNkulunkulu wathi: "Bhekani! Nginiphe zonke izitshalo emhlabeni wonke ezenza imbewu, nayo yonke imithi ethela izithelo ezinembewu. Kuzoba ukudla kwenu.
Futhi kuzo zonke izilwane zomhlaba, zonke izinyoni zezulu nazo zonke izidalwa ezihamba phansi, konke okunomoya wokuphila, nginika zonke izitshalo eziluhlaza zibe ukudla." Kwaba njengoba esho.
UNkulunkulu wabheka konke ayekwenzile, futhi kwakukuhle kakhulu. Kwahlwa, kwase kusa. Lolo kwakuwusuku lwesithupha.
Ngakho izulu nomhlaba kwaqedwa, kanye nakho konke okukukho.
Ngosuku lwesikhombisa uNkulunkulu wayesewuqedile umsebenzi ayewenza. Ngakho ngosuku lwesikhombisa waphumula kuwo wonke umsebenzi wakhe.

Le yindaba yezulu nomhlaba lapho kudalwa, ngesikhathi iNkosi uNkulunkulu yenza umhlaba nezulu.
Kwakungakabikho sihlahla emhlabeni, futhi kwakungakamili sitshalo emasimini. INkosi uNkulunkulu yayingakayinisi imvula emhlabeni, futhi kwakungekho muntu wokulima umhlabathi.
Kodwa inkungu yenyuka emhlabeni yamanzisa yonke indawo yomhlabathi.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yabumba indoda ngothuli lomhlabathi. Yaphefumulela umoya wokuphila emakhaleni endoda, indoda yaba yisidalwa esiphilayo.

INkosi uNkulunkulu yamilisa emhlabathini zonke izinhlobo zemithi. Yayimihle ukuyibuka futhi ilungele ukudliwa. Phakathi nensimu kwakumi umuthi wokuphila nomuthi wokwazi okuhle nokubi.
Umfula wawugeleza uphuma e-Edeni ukuze unisele insimu. Ukusuka lapho wahlukana waba yimifula emine.

INkosi uNkulunkulu yanika indoda lo myalo: "Ukhululekile ukudla kunoma yimuphi umuthi osensimini,
kodwa akumele udle emthini wokwazi okuhle nokubi. Ngosuku ozodla kuwo, uzofa nakanjani."
INkosi uNkulunkulu yathi: "Akukuhle ukuba indoda ibe yodwa. Ngizoyenzela umsizi oyifanele ngempela."

INkosi uNkulunkulu yabumba ngomhlabathi zonke izilwane zasendle nazo zonke izinyoni zezulu. Yaziletha endodeni ukuze ibone ukuthi izoziqamba ngamaphi amagama. Noma yiliphi igama indoda eyaliqamba isidalwa ngasinye esiphilayo, laba yigama laso.

INkosi uNkulunkulu yenza indoda yalala ubuthongo obukhulu. Isalele, uNkulunkulu wathatha olunye lwezimbambo zayo, wavala indawo leyo ngenyama.
INkosi uNkulunkulu yenza owesifazane ngembambo eyayiyikhiphe endodeni, yamletha endodeni.
Indoda yathi: "Ekugcineni! Nangu umuntu oyithambo lamathambo ami nenyama yenyama yami. Uzobizwa ngokuthi 'owesifazane', ngoba wathathwa endodeni."
